La guerra in corso tra USA‑Israele e Iran, evidenziata negli articoli, aggiunge un fattore di rischio geopolitico (2 punti). sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 19.99 (just under 20) signals a defensive market; the S&P 500 fell 1.09% to 7,659.44, indicating bearish pressure. The DXY is flat at 101.83 (-0.01%), while Brent dropped 1.83% to $107.85, confirming commodity weakness. Gold is up only 0.41% to $4,198.20, a modest gain. Ongoing war between the US‑Israel coalition and Iran, highlighted in the news, adds geopolitical risk (2 points). The mix of a near‑threshold VIX, negative equities, and war‑driven risk yields a risk‑off sentiment.
